1.consolidated_definition: Caída del gallo durante la pelea con el lomo contra suelo y las patas hacia arriba, lo que le dificulta volver a su posición normal. En Ponce se le llama .
1.en_consolidated_definition: Fall of the rooster during a fight with its back against the ground and legs upwards, making it difficult to return to its normal position. In Ponce, this is also known as "caída del gallo".
